details: Package name '@403name/ether-js' resembles the popular 'ethers' / 'ethers.js' Ethereum library, which is a known target for name-confusion in the npm ecosystem. No installer-harm behavior (exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, credential access, dropper, silent-relay, or known-bad infrastructure) was observed in the package contents. Name-similarity alone is a subjective signal and not sufficient to confirm malicious intent, so this is routed for human review rather than auto-blocked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
